svg.text: About 6.4 m of 15.88 x 1.24 stainless tube in one length, bent

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into two layers of five runs; bends 47.6 radius (a standard

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5/8 in bender), runs 95 apart, bend tips 290 each side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre. Layers 45 and 105 above the roof plate, joined by a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Water goes in at the top layer and out at the bottom layer, both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at the right end, 152 in front of the centre: the hottest gas

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: meets the last of the water (counterflow).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
